scope: Fix account changes reusing a previous-owner store refresh while preserving shared summary reads and retained category position

resolved_findings.before: Account B reused account A refresh future: reused=true, 2 HTTP reads including initial A load, displayed isLiked=true from A.
resolved_findings.after: Account B starts a new owner generation: reused=false, 3 HTTP reads including initial A load, displayed isLiked=false for A-only like.
changes: Expose an optional synchronous repository identity and auth-owner stream through TemplateSessionSource without breaking existing stateless/fake repository implementations.
Share one owner subscription among browse, search and local/full template catalogs; ignore same-owner token renewals and cancel the subscription at provider disposal.

On an account change, invalidate the old generation and clear old first-page/paging/refresh interests, remote rows, old likes and sync timestamp. Preserve the current route filters and widget/controller ownership.

Restart the selected query automatically for the new owner. Refresh/loadMore/setFilters/refreshIfStale also check the synchronous owner before reusing pending work, covering asynchronous auth-event delivery.
Validate both generation and current owner before any async success/error updates the feed; old replies cannot stop the new owner loading state or replace its list/error.
Bind local/full catalogs and persisted-like overlays to the same owner, reject stale metadata snapshots, and use the current SDK owner instead of delayed secure storage when identity is available.
Keep stateless/offline metadata and legacy token-storage fallback working when the optional repository identity is unavailable.

checked: Old-success-first, old-error-first and old-success-last all preserve the new owner query, loading flags, page zero and final list identity.
Account replacement and logout restart an initially pending feed without requiring a manual refresh. Rapid A-to-B-to-A transitions reject both older generations.
Same-account renewal does not restart the refresh. Twelve successive search scopes share one auth subscription, and the count returns to zero when the root is disposed.
Persisted A and guest likes cannot overlay B; a late A full-catalog response is ignored after B completes.
Parent/search same-query transport sharing, different-query isolation, old-page error guards and closed-scope cleanup remain covered.
No recurring timer, auth call per scroll, expanded image/document cache, larger decode target or eager template document build is added.
StoreScreen, StoreHubScreen and StoreTopicShelf are byte-for-byte unchanged. Existing horizontal/vertical position retention and rapid animated navigation cases pass.
Device-local CatalogFavorites ownership/storage semantics are unchanged; the account-specific isLiked overlay is separately guarded.

initial_repairs: Corrected a Dart unrelated-interface conditional assignment with an explicit checked cast before rerunning tests.

The persisted/full-catalog fixture now keeps an active provider listener, matching a mounted consumer; a bare read does not force lazy dependency rebuilds. The original state assertions remain intact.

supabase_verification.api_used: Public onAuthStateChange/currentUser only; internal sync auth streams are not used.
supabase_verification.test_query: Actual Supabase client/repository query and auth-session paths intercepted using MockClient at fixture.invalid. No live account, service key, database policy or production data was accessed.

limits: Controlled tests verify response ordering, retained state, transport sharing and listener cleanup. Real-device FPS and native heap/RSS peaks were not measured.
Invalidation ignores earlier work rather than cancelling already-running HTTP operations. Existing in-flight registry capacity and completed-response release policy are unchanged.
